android_aosp_zh_tw.description: AOSP default for a zh-TW device: Roboto for Latin and digits, Noto Sans CJK TC for Han and Bopomofo, Noto Sans CJK SC as fallback. Pixel and most near-stock ROMs ship this pair; brand ROMs (Samsung, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo) may replace it.

ios_zh_tw.description: iOS/macOS for a zh-TW device: SF Pro for Latin and digits, PingFang TC for Han and Bopomofo, PingFang SC as fallback. Apple fonts may not be copied or redistributed: run this stack only on a Mac, with the fonts that ship with macOS. Paths and face indexes are filled in by scripts/find_apple_fonts.py.

sensitivity_jf_openhuninn.description: Font-sensitivity check only (not a phone default): Roboto for Latin and digits, jf open 粉圓 2.1 (SIL OFL 1.1, rounded design) for Han and Bopomofo, Noto Sans CJK TC/SC for glyphs it lacks.
